options.name: label
options.description: Visible group label and accessible name of the role=group around both fields.

options.name: startLabel
options.description: Accessible name of the start field (visually hidden). Default: localized 'Start date'.

options.name: endLabel
options.description: Accessible name of the end field (visually hidden). Default: localized 'End date'.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial inclusive range (start <= end); also the value restored by reset().

options.name: min
options.description: Inclusive lower bound for both dates (validation and calendar).

options.name: max
options.description: Inclusive upper bound for both dates (validation and calendar).

options.name: minDays
options.description: Minimum range length in days, counting the start and end day (integer 1-100000).

options.name: maxDays
options.description: Maximum range length in days, counting the start and end day (integer 1-100000).

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name; Form and the hidden input carry the ISO 8601 interval YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD.

options.name: startName
options.description: Field name of the start date's own hidden input (YYYY-MM-DD) for native form posts.

options.name: endName
options.description: Field name of the end date's own hidden input (YYYY-MM-DD) for native form posts.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Both dates are required (value-missing).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables both fields and the calendar button; a disabled picker is not submitted.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Prevents editing; the calendar button is disabled.

options.name: isDateDisabled
options.description: Disable days in the calendar; a typed disabled start or end day is invalid ('date-unavailable'). Days between the ends are not checked.

options.name: businessCalendar
options.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

options.name: disableNonWorking
options.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation, run when the field and range constraints pass; return a message to mark the value invalid (error 'custom').

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First calendar column (ISO weekday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: closeOnSelect
options.description: Close the popup after the last day of the range is picked.

options.name: months
options.description: Months in the popup. 'auto': two when the viewport is at least 40rem wide when the popup opens, else one. Applied on the next open.

options.name: locale
options.description: Segment order, calendar, messages, formatting; forwarded to all children.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Zone used only to determine today in the calendar.

options.name: direction
options.description: Arrow-key mirroring, calendar direction, and popup alignment.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component. Registered with Form.

properties.name: group
properties.description: The labelled role=group around both fields.

properties.name: startInput
properties.description: Start date field (date granularity); not registered with Form.

properties.name: endInput
properties.description: End date field; the calendar button and popup sit inside its boundary. Not registered with Form.

properties.name: calendar
properties.description: The range Calendar (selectionMode 'range') inside the popup.

properties.name: button
properties.description: Calendar button inside the end field boundary.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The inclusive range, or null when empty, incomplete, or failing a field or range check (a custom error from validate or setCustomError keeps the range).

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message, field }; field is the field that shows the message ('start' | 'end' | null).

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Either date differs from its initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left either date field at least once.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the calendar on the range start (else the typed start date, else today) and focus it. No-op when disabled or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the calendar; an unfinished pick is discarded. Focus inside the popup returns to the calendar button.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no aui-change); writes both fields and clears an external custom error. Throws when start > end.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options to both fields and the calendar; closes the popup when disabled or read-only.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show both fields' messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule), shown on the end field; cleared when the user changes either date. null or '' clears it.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 interval YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD, or null when there is no valid range.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the first segment of the start date.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial range, and clear the custom error and touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close and remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions of the picker and its children.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: User typing or a completed calendar pick changed the value or validity. Dispatched from the picker host; the inner Date Input and Calendar change events are not exposed.

events.name: aui-navigate
events.description: Bubbles from the inner Calendar when the user changes the visible months; month is the first visible month.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__label
cssClasses.description: Visible group label (with the required indicator).

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__fields
cssClasses.description: Flex row of start field, separator, and end field; wraps when narrow.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__start | __end
cssClasses.description: Hosts of the inner Date Inputs (aui-date-input classes apply inside; their labels are visually hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__separator
cssClasses.description: Decorative en dash between the fields (aria-hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__trailing
cssClasses.description: Button and popup container inside the end Date Input group.

cssClasses.name: aui-date-range-picker__popup
cssClasses.description: Top-layer dialog popup containing the Calendar (aui-calendar classes apply inside).
